title: Freelance Hourly Rate to Make $100k a Year (Net Take-Home Pay)
metaDescription: Want to earn $100,000 net as a freelancer? Calculate your exact minimum hourly billing rate accounting for unbilled hours, self-employment taxes, and health insurance.
h1: Freelance Rate Needed to Net $100k Annually

faqs.question: What hourly rate equals $100k net salary for a freelancer?
faqs.answer: To take home $100,000 clean after taxes (28%) and $4,800 annual overhead, billing 30 hours per week across 48 weeks requires a minimum rate of $100.28/hour.

faqs.question: Why can't I just divide $100,000 by 2,080 hours ($48/hr)?
faqs.answer: Dividing by 2,080 assumes 40 billable hours every week without unpaid admin, marketing, sick days, self-employment tax (15.3%), or private health insurance.

title: Fiverr Price Calculator: How to Net $3,000/Month (After 20% Cut)
metaDescription: Calculate how much to price your Fiverr gigs and custom orders to walk away with $3,000 net in your bank after Fiverr's 20% platform commission and income taxes.
h1: Fiverr Gig Pricing Formula for $3,000/Month Net

faqs.question: How much does Fiverr take from my earnings?
faqs.answer: Fiverr retains 20% of every transaction, including tips. To net $3,000/month after taxes (~22%), you must bill $4,910 in gross gig sales each month.
